maneuvers.label: Heavy Swing
maneuvers.description: You wind up and swing with everything you have: one more AP, a harder roll, half again the damage, and a hit that lands staggers the target.

maneuvers.label: Quick Strike
maneuvers.description: A fast flick of a light blade: one AP less than an attack, for half the damage.

maneuvers.label: Trip
maneuvers.description: You hook a leg or sweep low instead of cutting deep: a harder roll for half the damage, and a hit puts the target on the ground unless it saves against your weapon's attribute.

maneuvers.label: Disarm
maneuvers.description: You go for the weapon, not the body: a harder roll for half the damage, and a hit makes the target drop its weapon unless it saves against your weapon's attribute.

maneuvers.label: Tripping Shot
maneuvers.description: You shoot or throw low, at the legs: a harder shot for half the damage, and a hit puts the target on the ground unless it saves against your weapon's attribute.

maneuvers.label: Disarming Shot
maneuvers.description: You shoot or throw at the weapon hand: a harder shot for half the damage, and a hit makes the target drop its weapon unless it saves against your weapon's attribute.

maneuvers.label: Split Nock
maneuvers.description: You nock two arrows at once and loose them together: one more AP, two arrows spent, a strike each at a harder roll, at one target or at two standing close together.

maneuvers.label: Held Breath
maneuvers.description: You take the aimed shot and hold your breath for the moment it needs: one more AP on the aimed attack, a far easier roll, half again the damage, and a wider crit window, with a long-ranged weapon and only when you have not moved this turn.

maneuvers.label: Pinning Shot
maneuvers.description: You put the shot where the target has to duck: a harder roll, and a hit that is not evaded pins it, so it loses AP on its next turn and cannot disengage.

maneuvers.label: Pinning Fire
maneuvers.description: You spend the rest of your turn and a volley of rounds on a patch of ground until your next turn: a foe in it attacks at a penalty, and each foe that first moves in it or into it takes a strike, while the rounds last.

maneuvers.label: Trigger Watch
maneuvers.description: You hold the shot from your held AP until your next turn: the first foe that moves or attacks in range draws it at a harder roll, and the AP comes back when none does. It is no opportunity attack and spends no reaction.
